t: This is the Royal Hospital for Neuro-disability in Putney, an independent charity providing rehabilitation and long-term care for people with complex neurological disabilities. The building is Grade II listed. The magician David Devant died here. Born in Holloway, he is remembered by magicians for his suave and witty presentation of stage illusion. The magic historian Jim Steinmeyer called him England's greatest magician, and arguably the greatest of the twentieth century.
